covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Wednesday, September 30, 2026 close and before the Thursday, October 1, 2026 open

market_context_summary: Cooler-than-expected August PCE supported equities and eased yields intraday, but the 10-year yield remained above 5% and oil near $90 kept valuation and input-cost risk elevated.

top_setups.note: No third evidence-qualified downward setup was available in the strict window.

methodology.disparity_scale: 0-100; normalized spread and call disagreement across the three passes
methodology.learned_lessons_update: Applied the repeated expectation-bar, key-metric-first, and forward-look override checks; no new framework change was made.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Debt/integration costs or cautious FY27 tone
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A preannounced high-end quarter, upward estimate revisions, and Domo strategic upside favor a positive reaction if integration economics and forward guidance remain credible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $1.52-$1.55 adjusted EPS and $247-$252 million revenue; the market is focused on Domo's contribution and integration.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: High-end or better results plus accretive Domo guidance and resilient recurring revenue.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Integration costs, leverage, or conservative FY27 commentary outweigh the quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move figure found; analyst coverage is uniformly positive, which raises the bar modestly.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Five upward and no downward EPS revisions over 30 days were reported by StockDecider; five covering analysts were Buy-rated in Kiplinger/Refinitiv data.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Soft lighting demand or tariff noise
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Positive sales and mix momentum, especially in Intelligent Spaces, supports upside if margin quality persists without relying on tariff refunds.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is approximately $5.3-$5.7 adjusted EPS and $1.25 billion revenue; options imply about a 9.4% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AIS-led mix, continued margin expansion, and constructive FY27 commentary.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ABL weakness, tariffs, or normalization of one-time benefits exposes a demanding implied move.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied approximately a 9.4% move as of September 28, making magnitude harder than direction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revision data was mixed but net positive in one calendar feed; Morgan Stanley raised its target to $410 while maintaining Overweight.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY27 HBM/DRAM outlook and gross margin
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Beat priced in; margin/capex peak fears
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record memory economics and contracted AI demand favor upside, but the stock and estimates already discount an extraordinary outcome.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus clusters near $31.5-$32.3 EPS and $51-$52 billion revenue versus company guidance of $50 billion and about 86% gross margin.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue and gross margin clear elevated whispers and FY27 supply discipline extends peak profitability.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line print, softer FY27 margins, or heavier capex triggers a sell-the-news reversal.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options sources imply roughly 8.5%-10.3%; shares were reported up about 256% year to date, with visible call enthusiasm and some large bearish hedges.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Street sentiment remained strongly positive, but the buy-side bar appears above published consensus after repeated estimate increases.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The quarter needs to validate sequential Consumer volume improvement, while price gaps, commodity costs, and transaction complexity leave more downside than upside around a still-low growth profile.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.76 EPS and $1.98 billion revenue; options pricing sources range from about 4% to 8.4%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Consumer volume improves sooner than expected while pricing and CCI protect margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Volume remains weak, commodity inflation persists, or acquisition financing/integration concerns dominate.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options estimates conflict by vendor, reducing confidence in the magnitude benchmark; historical reactions have often stayed below the larger estimate.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent calendar data showed more downward than upward revisions and consensus EPS below the prior year.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Compressed valuation and AI relief squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Soft bookings and a narrowed FY26 growth outlook make FY27 organic growth guidance the deciding signal, despite strong cash conversion and a de-rated valuation.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.18-$3.19 EPS and $18.0-$18.1 billion revenue; investors are focused on bookings and FY27 guidance rather than Q4 EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Advanced-AI bookings and FY27 organic growth guidance show reacceleration, prompting a valuation relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Bookings remain soft and AI disruption or federal exposure pressures FY27 growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable current implied-move data was not found; the stock's major 2026 drawdown increases relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: One calendar source showed more downward than upward 30-day revisions; the prior quarter narrowed full-year local-currency growth guidance to 3%-4%.
